philosophy: TypeSpec and JSON Schema are independently authored. Generators (and proto3) lose or reshape some facts. Those edges are listed here. Anything not listed is a veto.

deltas.reason: proto3 enums require a 0 value. JSON Schema and TypeSpec have no unspecified transport.
proto3 has no untyped JSON object; those fields are bytes on the wire ledger.
JSON Schema uses allOf/if/then; TypeSpec uses a union of models. Semantic arms must still match.
TypeSpec models do not emit unevaluatedProperties; closedness is per-model.
Authored JSON Schema is fail-closed (additionalProperties false). TypeSpec default openness is a known edge.
JSON Schema constrains propertyNames; TypeSpec uses Record<string>.
Protobuf is one flattened message so field numbers stay append-only; JSON Schema variants are if/then.
